summary: Configured and verified the routed PostgreSQL HA cluster. node2 is the writable Patroni leader; node3 and node4 stream `appdb`, with node4 synchronous. Router forwarding and saved firewall rules restrict LAN traffic to HA/database ports.
actions_performed: Installed and configured PostgreSQL 16, Patroni, and a three-member etcd DCS.
Created `appdb`, replication credentials, application credentials, and verified committed data on both replicas.
Enabled automatic failover, rewind/reclone recovery, boot persistence, and service restart policies.
Saved VyOS configuration and validated live health, routes, listeners, replication, and access controls.
